description_en: Calls this operation to list the resource types of a service
kebab_example: aliyun cloudcontrol list-resource-types --x-acs-accept-language zh_CH --provider Aliyun --product ECS --resource-types Instance --next-token ECS::Disk --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResourceTypes

parameters.help_en:
Select the language in which the response is returned.

zh_CH: Chinese (default).

en_US: English
parameters.help_zh:
选择返回产品的语言。

zh_CH：中文 （默认）

en_US：英文
parameters.name: x_acs_accept_language

parameters.help_en: The Cloud service provider. Only Aliyun is supported
parameters.name: provider

parameters.help_en: The information about the resource types
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: max_results
